checked_sources: On the powers of the descent set statistic, Theorem 2.9 (multinomial Kummer)
correctness.rationale: Using the classical boundary-format degree \(D=(N+1)!/(k_1!\cdots k_r!)=(N+1)\binom{N}{k_1,\ldots,k_r}\), Legendre’s digit-sum formula gives the displayed valuation exactly. The multinomial Kummer theorem identifies the second term with the number of base-\(p\) carries. For \(p=2\), carry-free addition is equivalent to pairwise-disjoint binary supports, and positivity of all summands makes unordered decompositions bijective with set partitions of the \(s_2(N)\) one-bits, giving \(S(s_2(N),r)\).
